# TF-0424 context lifecycle exploration evidence

Agent-driven, shadow-only evidence for the three TF-0424 exploration paths.

## Files

- `boundary.json`: no production runtime imports the exploration modules; no
  default or product-lock change.
- `soft-threshold.json`: soft-threshold, CAS mismatch, background failure
  fallback and manual/overflow sync scenarios.
- `value-pruning.json`: deterministic candidate generation, would-drop metrics,
  credential scan zero on eligible candidates and provider seam coverage.
- `segment-summary.json`: digest reuse, T0/T1/T2 rollup and budget/target-driven
  assembly token curve.
- `existing-compression-baseline.json`: aggregate metrics from the existing
  deterministic compression evaluation runner; no live LLM stages were run.
- `stage1-baseline.json`: partial pre-change economics; first-token and
  compaction wall-clock remain unmeasured.
- `value-pruning-eval.json`, `segment-summary-eval.json`,
  `soft-threshold-eval.json`: track-level NO-GO decisions and boundaries.
- `decisions.json`: TF-0435/TF-0436 decisions and the TF-0424 final no-default-on
  conclusion.

## Reproduce

```powershell
$env:CONTEXT_LIFECYCLE_BOUNDARY_OUT='harness/specs/fixtures/tf0424-context-lifecycle/boundary.json'
$env:CONTEXT_LIFECYCLE_SOFT_THRESHOLD_OUT='harness/specs/fixtures/tf0424-context-lifecycle/soft-threshold.json'
$env:CONTEXT_LIFECYCLE_VALUE_PRUNING_OUT='harness/specs/fixtures/tf0424-context-lifecycle/value-pruning.json'
$env:CONTEXT_LIFECYCLE_SEGMENT_OUT='harness/specs/fixtures/tf0424-context-lifecycle/segment-summary.json'
pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/context-lifecycle-*.test.ts
```

The existing compression baseline was generated by
`node scripts/context-compression-eval-runner.mjs` with its default daily
hybrid suite. The retained comparison is a 12-sample PASS with 5 real / 7
synthetic samples and videnceInsufficient=true; no live judge, schema-free,
continuation or critic stage was requested.

## Boundary

All three new paths remain shadow/bypass prototypes. No product default,
prompt order, compaction timing, storage authority, provider call or Task
Ledger/ClawGraph authority was changed. The NO-GO decisions are valid outcomes;
they do not claim that the shadow estimates are production quality or cost
measurements.
